pages.en:
Arms Identification Section.
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. L. REGISTRY
No. S. B. D. 2277
9th October 1931）
(C. & S.B.) Office Notes
Sir,
With reference to the attached, at 6 p.m. on the 3-11-31
I was instructed that the staff of this Section could take one
half day each on either Monday, Tuesday or Wednesday, providing
that someone remained in the office.
On the 3-11-31 there was too much work in hand for
anyone to leave the office, therefore I informed D.P.S. Ewins
that he could take the next afternoon, Wednesday, and if all
the urgent work was finished I would stay in quarters during
the morning where I would be if wanted.
The above arrangements were made to suit the Section
and its work and were accordingly carried out on the belief
that they were in compliance with instructions.
（批：afternoon
J.H.
9/11/31.）
P.A. (Crime). A 10/11/31
M.E. Bowen
D.S.I.

枪械识别科。
（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处
刑事与特别科登记室
编号 S. B. D. 2277
1931年10月9日）
（刑事与特别科）办公笔记
先生，
关于附件所述事项，1931年11月3日下午6时，
我接到指示，本科人员可在星期一、星期二或星期三中任选一天休半天假，前提是
办公室内须留有人值守。
1931年11月3日，手头工作繁多，无人
能离开办公室，因此我告知副巡捕总监尤因斯先生（D.P.S. Ewins），他可于次日（星期三）下午休假，若所有紧急工作均已完成，我将在上午留在宿舍，如有需要可随时找到我。
上述安排是为了适应本科及其工作需要，并基于相信这些安排符合指示而执行。
（批注：下午
J.H.
1931年11月9日。）
助理局长（刑事科）。1931年11月10日
M.E. 鲍恩
副巡捕总监
